title: WisdomDesign Page Spec v1.1
description: Platform-neutral page exchange contract. It excludes Swift/Kotlin/platform API types and is not a runtime UI VM.

x-semanticRules.NO_PRIMARY_ACTION: page.primaryAction is required for the M0 golden-page profile; M1 validator assigns the code.
x-semanticRules.PLATFORM_TYPE_LEAK: regions[].component must be a canonical WD ID; platform-shaped strings are rejected by enum.
x-semanticRules.COLLECTION_MISSING_EMPTY: collection pages must include an empty state.
x-semanticRules.UNKNOWN_COMPONENT: regions[].component enum is the 37 canonical IDs from contracts.
x-semanticRules.UNKNOWN_FIELD: additionalProperties is false at every object level.
x-semanticRules.MULTIPLE_PRIMARY_ACTIONS: At most one region may resolve to primary emphasis. Emphasis is derived: a region is primary when its action equals page.primaryAction, or when its component is WDFAB, or when its resolved variant (regions[].variant, falling back to the contract default) is `filled`. Declaring the variant is therefore enough to mark a secondary action without touching kind.
x-semanticRules.UNKNOWN_VARIANT: regions[].variant must be a value the component contract declares in contracts-digest.json enums, or match its default. An unknown variant is a typo, not a design decision.
x-semanticRules.PRIMARY_ACTION_NOT_CONNECTED: page.primaryAction must be performed by some region (regions[].action). A declared primary action that no region carries is a dangling intent.
x-semanticRules.NAVIGATION_CONFLICT: A tabRoot page must not use WDNavigationBar: a top-level page has no back affordance, and the component spec says so explicitly.
x-semanticRules.UNREGISTERED_EXTENSION: regions[].extension.id must appear in page-spec/extensions.json. Proposed extensions pass with a warning so a product-specific composition has a legal home instead of an invented component ID.
x-semanticRules.STATE_INCOMPLETE: collection pages need an empty state (hard error); missing loading/content/error states are reported as warnings because not every page owns all of them.

schemaVersion.description: Page Spec schema version, independent from Skill/Token/component-library versions.

profile.description: Optional frozen profile name; core, single-platform, or cross-platform.

primaryAction.description: Stable business action ID, not a platform selector or API call.

kind.description: Region PURPOSE only. Emphasis is derived from variant/defaults, never declared here: when kind also gated emphasis, changing it to `custom` silently switched the one-primary-action rule off (M-2). `custom` is retired in 1.1 for the same reason.

variant.description: Component variant for this region (e.g. filled / tonal / plain for WDButton). Validated against contracts-digest.json enums; emphasis is resolved from it plus the contract default, so a spec can state two secondary buttons without being read as two primaries.

action.description: Stable business action ID this region performs. A region whose action matches page.primaryAction IS the primary action, so `primaryAction` stops being a dangling string.

extension.description: Controlled extension channel for a product-specific composition based on a canonical component. Unregistered ids fail; registered ones pass with a warning. Replaces the old choice between inventing an ID and lying about `kind`.

component.description: Single canonical component or recipe ID; no platform types.

itemPattern.description: Canonical row pattern from docs/specs/03-patterns.md (R1-R5) or a registered extension id. Free text was accepted by a pattern regex that only proved the first letter was uppercase, so `TotallyMadeUp` validated.

overrides.description: Platform-neutral policy overrides only; no Swift/Kotlin types or API calls.

platforms.description: Optional platform status annotations. A single-platform task may omit Page Spec entirely; presence here is not required for code generation.
